item.subject: science
item.stem: Meera takes a variegated leaf (with green and white patches) from her potted croton plant at home in Kochi. She keeps the plant in bright sunlight for six hours, then boils the leaf, removes the chlorophyll, and tests it with iodine solution. Which observation should she predict?

options.A: Both the green and white patches turn blue-black because the whole leaf was in sunlight
options.B: Only the green patches turn blue-black, showing starch formed only where chlorophyll received sunlight
options.C: Only the white patches turn blue-black because they absorb more sunlight
options.D: No patch turns blue-black because a variegated leaf cannot make starch
